# EV-Friendly Luxury Hotels & Villas in Bali: Ubud, Seminyak & Uluwatu Charging Guide

Bali in 2026 is a surprisingly capable EV destination. With over 80 public charging points across the island (up from just 15 in 2024), a growing rental fleet of BYD Atto 3s and Hyundai Ioniq 5s, and luxury hotels that have embraced EV charging as a core amenity, the Island of the Gods is ready for your electric adventure.

The best part? Bali's luxury hotels have gone all-in on EV hospitality. From solar-powered chargers at cliffside resorts to butler-managed valet charging at private villas, the EV experience here often exceeds what you'll find in major cities.

This guide covers Bali's top luxury properties for EV drivers, organized by region, with detailed charging specs, local driving tips, and affiliate-linked activities near each hotel.

---

## EV Charging in Bali: What You Need to Know

- **Connector standard:** CCS2 (Type 2 AC / CCS2 DC). Bring your own Type 2 cable — some chargers don't have tethered cables.
- **Major networks:** PLN SPKLU (government, largest network), Ion (Casion — private, faster chargers), Charge+
- **Pricing:** IDR 2,200–2,450 per kWh at DC fast chargers. A full 60 kWh charge costs roughly IDR 140,000 ($9 USD). Hotel charging is almost always complimentary.
- **Range anxiety rating:** Moderate. Southern Bali (Seminyak, Canggu, Sanur, Nusa Dua) is well-covered. Ubud is manageable. East Bali (Amed, Besakih) has exactly one fast charger — plan accordingly.
- **Best EV for Bali:** BYD Atto 3 (420 km WLTP range, widely available for rent) or Hyundai Ioniq 5 (480 km, fast-charging capable)

> **Pro tip:** Download both the **SPKLU** and **Ion** apps before your trip. These two networks cover 90% of fast-charging locations on the island.

**The EV Experience:**
The Legian's legendary sunset views from the beachfront pool are worth the stay alone — your EV charging is a convenient bonus. The property's central Seminyak location means all the best restaurants, boutiques, and beach clubs are within walking distance. The valet team keeps a log of your preferred cabin temperature and will have your car pre-cooled and waiting when you're ready to explore.

## Top Luxury Hotels in Ubud with EV Charging

- **Location:** Covered, open-air parking area near the resort entrance
- **Cost:** Complimentary
- **Activation:** Valet-managed. The team charges your car and pre-cools the cabin before every excursion
- **Additional:** The resort offers a complimentary Tesla Model Y (or similar) for half-day excursions — fully charged and waiting

**The EV Experience:**
The approach road to Four Seasons Sayan, through a canopy of jungle trees, is one of Bali's most beautiful EV drives. The property's complementary Tesla for guest excursions is a thoughtful touch for guests who flew in and didn't bring their own car.

Ask for the "Green Suite" package, which includes EV charging, a guided electric buggy tour of Ubud, and a sustainability-focused spa treatment.

- **Location:** Secure parking area near the main building
- **Cost:** Complimentary — free electrons from the sun
- **Activation:** Valet-managed. The wellness team offers a "15-minute EV Recharge" express massage while you wait
- **Sustainability:** The entire resort runs on solar power, including the EV chargers, spa, and all villas

The resort offers complimentary electric buggy service to Uluwatu Temple (3 minutes away), so you can explore without moving your car.

## Private Villas with EV Charging in Bali

A growing trend among Bali's luxury villa market: EV charging as a standard amenity. Many high-end villas in Seminyak, Canggu, and Ubud now include:

- **Standard wall outlet charging** — 80–100 km overnight via portable EVSE
- **Dedicated Type 2 wallbox** — 22 kW, faster overnight top-ups
- **Solar-powered chargers** — eco-conscious villa owners are leading this trend

**Recommended villa agencies that filter for EV charging:**
- Villa Finder ("EV charging" filter available)
- Airbnb (check amenities section)
- Bali Private Villas (ask about EV when booking)

> **Pro tip:** When booking a private villa, ask the host about charging. If they have a standard 230V outlet in the garage, you can use your portable EVSE. Most villas with off-street parking can accommodate this.

## Sample Itinerary: 5-Day Luxury EV Trip Around Bali

### Day 1–2: Seminyak | The Legian Seminyak
- Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport. Pick up your BYD Atto 3 or Hyundai Ioniq 5 rental.
- First stop: **Ion Central Park Kuta** (150 kW CCS2, 10 min from airport) for a top-up
- Check into **The Legian Seminyak** — valet handles charging
- Evening: **[Seminyak sunset & seafood dinner](https://www.viator.com/Bali-tours/Dinner/d421-g8-c1?aid=P00299136)**
- Day 2: Relax by the beach, **[Waterbom Bali](https://www.klook.com/activity/815-waterbom-bali/?aid=119991)**, or **[Bali food tour](https://www.klook.com/activity/2815-bali-street-food-tour/?aid=119991)**

### Day 3: Ubud | Four Seasons at Sayan
- Morning: Drive Seminyak → Ubud (35 km, 1 hour). Scenic route via Batubulan
- Stop at **[Tegalalang Rice Terraces](https://www.viator.com/Bali-attractions/Tegalalang-Rice-Terrace/d421-a22914?aid=P00299136)** on the way
- Check into **Four Seasons Sayan** — complimentary Tesla loaner available for excursions
- Evening: **[Ubud Monkey Forest](https://www.klook.com/activity/939-ubud-monkey-forest-bali/?aid=119991)** & dinner at Ubud's famous restaurants

### Day 4: Uluwatu | Six Senses
- Morning: Drive Ubud → Uluwatu (50 km, 1.5 hours). Top up at **PLN SPKLU Jimbaran** (100 kW)
- Check into **Six Senses Uluwatu** — solar-powered EV charging
- Evening: **[Uluwatu Temple & Kecak Dance](https://www.klook.com/activity/501-uluwatu-kecak-dance-bali/?aid=119991)** — a 3-minute drive

### Day 5: Departure
- Final morning at Six Senses. Your car is fully charged from the solar array.
- Option: **[Jimbaran Bay lunch](https://www.viator.com/Bali-tours/Dinner/d421-g8-c1?aid=P00299136)** before heading to the airport
- Return EV rental at the airport (30-minute drive from Uluwatu)

**Total charging cost for 5 days:** IDR 0–100,000 ($0–6 USD) — almost entirely covered by complimentary hotel charging.

## Essential Tips for Luxury EV Travel in Bali

- **Pre-book your hotel's EV charger** — most luxury properties have only 1–2 chargers for all guests
- **Bring your Type 2 cable** — many hotel chargers in Bali don't have tethered cables
- **Use the Ion app for mall charging** — Central Park Kuta, Beachwalk, and Sanur all have Ion fast chargers
- **Avoid driving in southern Bali 4–7 PM** — Seminyak-Canggu traffic is notorious. Plan beach visits for morning or evening
- **Check villa charging before booking** — many luxury villas in Seminyak and Canggu now advertise EV charging. Confirm the connector type.
- **Charge at the airport on departure** — Ngurah Rai has 50 kW CCS2 chargers in the international terminal parking
- **The Ubud hills are real** — the climb from southern Bali to Ubud increases consumption by 25–30%. Factor this into your range planning.

## The Future of Luxury EV Hospitality in Bali

Bali's luxury hotel EV landscape is evolving fast:

- **Solar-powered charging** — Six Senses Uluwatu and Alila Villas are pioneers. Expect more resorts to follow
- **Complementary EV fleets** — Four Seasons Sayan's Tesla loaner program is a model for other luxury properties
- **Resort-to-charger shuttle service** — the growing trend of hotels offering e-buggy transport to nearby charging hubs
- **Government push** — Indonesia's target of 2 million EVs by 2030 is driving fast-charger deployment across Bali, including planned 150 kW stations in Ubud and Candidasa
